parameters.query:
SELECT d.status, d.pickup_location, d.delivery_location
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS tn) q
LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON d.tracking_number = q.tn
INSERT INTO escalations (customer_id, reason, priority) VALUES ($1, $2, 'MEDIUM') RETURNING id
INSERT INTO audit_logs (event_type, entity_type, entity_id, details) VALUES ('INTEGRATION_FAILURE', 'customer', $1, $2::jsonb)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Build Integration Failure Reply').item.json.customer_id, JSON.stringify({ service: 'tracking', tracking_number: $('Build Integration Failure Reply').item.json.context.tracking_number || null }) ] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversations (id, customer_id, current_intent, current_state, context, is_active)
VALUES (COALESCE($1::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), $2, 'TRACK_DELIVERY', $3, $4::jsonb, $5)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  current_intent = EXCLUDED.current_intent,
  current_state = EXCLUDED.current_state,
  context = EXCLUDED.context,
  is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING id

INSERT INTO messages (customer_id, conversation_id, direction, body, intent, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'OUTBOUND', $3, 'TRACK_DELIVERY', 'PROCESSED')
INSERT INTO audit_logs (event_type, entity_type, entity_id, details) VALUES ('TRACKING_REQUEST', 'customer', $1, $2::jsonb)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Finalize Payload').item.json.customer_id, JSON.stringify({ tracking_number: $('Finalize Payload').item.json.context.tracking_number || null, found: $('Finalize Payload').item.json.found || false }) ] }}
